purpose: Local backend boundary for Codex CLI, MCP, filesystem, VPS, MT4/MT5, Telegram, and other real tools.
base_url_semantics: Preferred first-run URL only; the confirmed runtime URL comes from runtime_endpoint.source.

runtime_endpoint.confirmAfter: GET /api/health returns the same host and port
runtime_endpoint.rule: Never randomize the IP, expose LAN/public binding, stop another process, or store secrets in the endpoint file.

principles: Secrets, tokens, cookies, auth files, and credentials stay outside the frontend.
Real Codex/MCP/tool execution requires backend audit and approval gates.
Dangerous actions default to blocked or waiting_approval.

The three AI Trade Council agents remain read-only. The Backend waits for all three snapshot-bound votes, applies the audited 1/3, 2/3, or 3/3 directional threshold with an any-BUY-plus-SELL veto, and dispatches only when validated stopLossPrice, takeProfitPrice, Quality, Risk, and EA gates also pass.
AI Trade Council displayBars is a frontend-only chart preference; analysisBarCount is Backend-owned, audited, closed-bars-only, and must never be silently reduced.
AI and Frontend never provide Lot, Risk Percent, position size, Gateway mode, or Live arm state. Fixed Lot, mode, and LiveArmed remain installed MT4 EA inputs.

maxManagedOrders is a human-selected Backend dispatch cap with allowed values 1, 3, 5, or 10. The effective cap is the lower of this value and the fresh EA MaxManagedOpenPositions telemetry. Current usage is the higher of fresh EA telemetry and selected-channel OPEN or not-yet-reconciled Orders proven by durable EXECUTED ACK, preventing status-publish lag from exceeding the cap. It never changes the EA input, never closes an existing position, and fails closed when telemetry is unavailable.

endpoints.GET /api/health: Fast side-effect-free Bridge and critical UI readiness check. It does not invoke Codex CLI or MCP.
endpoints.GET /api/bridge/status: Detect local runner, Codex auth state, MCP config, and approval policy.
endpoints.GET /api/operator-mode: Read manual_guarded or auto_guarded mode, Thai label, auto-execution policy, worker state, and updated time.
endpoints.POST /api/operator-mode: Accept exactly one mode field, persist the local operator mode, and write an audit record. The installation default is auto_guarded; a legacy v1 manual_guarded record is migrated only when its persisted source proves it came from contract_default, while local_operator_api choices are preserved.
endpoints.GET /api/collaboration/schedule: Read the backend-owned Agent collaboration schedule, daily usage, next eligible time, active meeting, and Rate Guard pause reason.
endpoints.POST /api/collaboration/schedule: Persist only allowlisted schedule fields. The default is disabled; every automatic meeting requires Full Access and a fresh Codex quota reserve.
endpoints.POST /api/collaboration/run-now: Queue one explicit tool-free Agent meeting. It still enforces Full Access, daily cap, cooldown, fresh Rate Limit, single-run lock, Mission, transcript, report, and audit.
endpoints.GET /api/capabilities: Read the sanitized, contract-owned capability registry and distinguish ready, approval-gated, unimplemented, and disabled adapters.
endpoints.GET /api/codex/rate-limits: Read a cached, frontend-safe Codex account quota snapshot from the authenticated local Codex app-server. No auth, account, plan, credit, path, or raw error data is exposed.
endpoints.POST /api/agents/chat: Run one role-bound, tool-free Codex conversation turn. The request contains only agentId, message, sessionId, and idempotencyKey. The Chat Runner returns conversation or task_request plus a safe taskGoal; for task_request the Backend creates an idempotent guarded Mission, routes explicit public-web intent to codex_web_research, and returns taskCreated, taskMissionIds, taskStatus, and autoExecute.
endpoints.POST /api/bridge/run: Create a guarded backend mission; approval-required tools are never executed in this request.
endpoints.POST /api/manager/delegate: Create a Manager parent plan and bounded specialist subtasks. Optional requestedOwnerAgentId and requestedTargetId are backend validated; when target is omitted the Backend selects one permitted workstation from the goal.
endpoints.GET /api/missions: Read the bounded runtime Mission queue by default; scope=all, admin, or full is required for the complete archive.
endpoints.GET /api/missions/:id: Read one complete frontend-safe Mission detail by exact id. Mission Table summary rows use this endpoint lazily.
endpoints.POST /api/missions: Create a mission without direct tool execution.
endpoints.POST /api/missions/:id/approval: Record the local human decision against the complete execution packet; required high-risk review is then issued only by backend Risk Guard policy.
endpoints.POST /api/missions/:id/execute: Execute only when stored mission approval is complete and unused, and the JSON body confirms the exact mission id.
endpoints.POST /api/agent-events: Append agent speech, route, report, or meeting event.
endpoints.GET /api/props/:id/report: Merge the prop contract, strictly routed missions/reports, memory, events, relevant meetings, sanitized Bridge state, and filtered capabilities into one dashboard read model. AI Council history and Mission Table rows are bounded cursor pages by default; scope=all, admin, or full is the explicit diagnostic export.
endpoints.GET /api/props/:id/connections: Read the cached/backend-computed Connection Checklist for one Dashboard without durable writes or frontend readiness inference.
endpoints.POST /api/props/:id/connections/refresh: Accept an explicit frontend intent, then run a cooldown-guarded read-only connection diagnostic with mission id, owner, status, audit, and a report routed back to that Dashboard.
endpoints.POST /api/integrations/metatrader/discov: Search bounded standard locations and process image names for MT4/MT5 in read-only mode. It never launches, closes, attaches, trades, or returns paths, PIDs, account, broker, or credentials.
endpoints.POST /api/integrations/metatrader/select: Accept only propId plus an opaque candidateId from a detected safe candidate, persist that dashboard's local target selection behind the Bridge, and create mission/report/audit records. Selection never attaches to a terminal, enables an adapter, or enables live trading.
endpoints.GET /api/ai-trade-council/status: Read the sanitized Council state, current MT4 snapshot readiness, latest consensus, and backend-owned new-closed-bar automation status without running Codex. liveAnalysis.consensus exposes identityValid plus candidateId/channelId, canonical streamKey, exact display symbol, timeframe, snapshotId, closedBarIdentity, and streamIdentity only when the immutable parent context and decision provenance agree exactly; a mismatch nulls the identity fields so the Frontend can fail closed.
endpoints.GET /api/ai-trade-council/history: Read a bounded cursor page with kind=analysis or kind=orders. scope=all is the default and Order history scans every durable Gateway channel page even when no MT4 target is currently selected; scope=active resolves the Backend-owned current candidateId, uppercase-canonical streamKey, exact display symbol and timeframe before filtering, summary calculation, and pagination and still requires the exact selected MT4 channel. Optional candidateId, streamKey, symbol and timeframe are validated optimistic-concurrency guards and never select an arbitrary historical stream. Analysis identity is attemptId first and closed-bar identity second; Order linkage uses exact mission id, with Snapshot fallback only for legacy ACK records that have no mission id. Response scope is authoritative and Order historyWindow truthfully declares scan completeness, ledger command count, and whether older rows remain.
endpoints.GET /api/ai-trade-council/automation: Read whether automatic analysis is enabled, its supported timeframes, Backend-audited analysisBarCount, durable FIFO/coverage cursor, pending count, daily count, quota reserve, and pause reason. This endpoint never creates a Mission.
endpoints.POST /api/ai-trade-council/automation: Enable or disable backend-owned analysis on a new closed bar, select analysisBarCount from 120, 180, 240, 300, 500, or 1000, select requiredVotes from 1, 2, or 3, set the human-selected Backend maxManagedOrders cap to 1, 3, 5, or 10, and select dailyRoundLimitMode as unlimited or limited. Every newly observed supported closed bar is recorded once in the durable FIFO. Backend captures an immutable snapshot at detection; gates retain the queue, while a delayed/stale snapshot is analysis-only and can never dispatch a trade command. Restart or jump bars without an exact captured snapshot become explicit skipped coverage rows. Unlimited mode returns effectiveMaxDailyRounds null; the stored maxDailyRounds value is compatibility data and is enforced only in limited mode. maxManagedOrders never changes the EA input and is enforced before command publication together with the EA final guard. The frontend cannot provide a bar key, model, tool, budget, or displayBars as analysis evidence.
endpoints.POST /api/ai-trade-council/analyze: Queue one explicit read-only Council round for the latest validated MT4 snapshot with optional analysisBarCount of 120, 180, 240, 300, 500, or 1000. Backend binds three specialist Missions to one exact closed-bar window and fails closed if requested and used counts differ.
endpoints.GET /api/mt4-trade-gateway/status: Read the sanitized post-consensus MT4 Trade Gateway status without queuing a command or changing EA state. Status v5 exposes validated account-wide portfolio-policy and same-Windows-user concurrency evidence. Status v4/v3 remains readable for diagnostics but is execution read-only with reason portfolio_policy_evidence_required. A fresh init failure PORTFOLIO_POLICY_MISMATCH is exposed as portfolioPolicyStatus=mismatch without accepting stale status. The default mode is shadow, automatic Council dispatch starts at M5, M1 remains manual-only, and only a configured 1/3, 2/3, or 3/3 direction with no opposing BUY/SELL vote and validated SL/TP is eligible for Backend dispatch.
endpoints.GET /api/mt4-trade-gateway/outcome?comma: Read the validated OPEN or CLOSED lifecycle evidence written by the EA for one exact command. This endpoint is read-only and never infers a fill.
endpoints.POST /api/mt4-trade-gateway/execution-un: Fail closed for one exact EXECUTION_UNKNOWN command using commandId plus the latest expectedLedgerRevision. The Backend activates the channel Kill Switch, retains the bar claim, releases only the durable command slot, audits the action, and never retries the order.
endpoints.GET /api/meetings/sessions: List bounded frontend-safe interactive meeting sessions without running an Agent or creating a Mission.
endpoints.GET /api/meetings/sessions/{id}: Read one exact meeting session, transcript, current proposal digest, approval state, and separately linked implementation Mission id.
endpoints.POST /api/meetings/sessions: Create a discussion-only meeting session plus one low-risk agent_collaboration discussion Mission for durable audit and background-round accounting. No tool, Workspace, implementation/code Mission, or implementation authority is granted.
endpoints.POST /api/meetings/sessions/{id}/message: Append a local-user interjection and start one bounded role-bound discussion round. The round may create one low-risk agent_collaboration discussion Mission for durable audit; Agent turns remain strictly tool-free and Workspace-free and cannot create an implementation/code Mission.
endpoints.POST /api/meetings/sessions/{id}/proposa: Freeze the current Manager proposal and its canonical proposalDigest without creating a Mission or granting implementation authority.
endpoints.POST /api/meetings/sessions/{id}/approve: Require one fresh explicit local-user confirmation bound to the exact meeting id and current proposalDigest, then create one separate approval-bound implementation Mission without executing it inline.
endpoints.POST /api/meetings/sessions/{id}/reject: Reject the exact current proposalDigest without creating or executing a Mission; any changed proposal requires a new decision.
endpoints.GET /api/props/mission_strategy_table/re: Read the frontend-safe central Research Sheet Hub state, fixed consumer-to-tab mappings, persisted Sheet id and canonical URL, Apply/verification progress, fail-closed adapter status, and outbox summary. A Google Sheet id is displayable configuration rather than a credential; OAuth tokens, service-account material, cookies, and other credentials are never exposed.

Read only the frontend-safe Google authorization state. The response may identify whether a durable local OAuth grant or environment fallback is usable, but never returns an access token, refresh token, authorization code, PKCE verifier, OAuth state, client secret, secure-store payload, or callback query.
endpoints.POST /api/props/mission_strategy_table/r: Accept exactly an empty JSON object and create one short-lived, one-use OAuth authorization attempt for the current local bridge. Return an HTTPS Google authorizationUrl containing PKCE S256, an opaque state parameter, access_type=offline, and prompt=consent. State is never returned as a standalone response field; the PKCE verifier remains Backend-only.
endpoints.GET /api/props/mission_strategy_table/re: Receive the exact Google redirect on the current 127.0.0.1 bridge port, consume and validate the short-lived state once, exchange the one-time code with the bound PKCE verifier, persist only the refresh token through Windows current-user DPAPI storage outside the project, and return a generic completion page. The raw query, code, state, verifier, token response, and refresh token are never logged, audited, persisted in runtime settings, or returned to the Agent HQ frontend.
endpoints.POST /api/props/mission_strategy_table/r: Accept exactly an empty JSON object and delete the durable local OAuth grant plus every pending authorization attempt. Environment credentials, when separately configured by the operator, are not deleted and remain an explicit fallback reported by the safe auth read model.

Accept exactly googleSheetUrlOrId. Inspect the candidate with Backend-only credentials, verify the three fixed tabs and key-column read probes, and return verificationPreview plus the unchanged active researchSheet. A short-lived one-time verificationToken is returned only when all three probes are ready. Inspection never replaces the active Sheet revision.

Accept exactly verificationToken, confirmActivate=true, expectedConfigRevision, and idempotencyKey. Re-check the three fixed tabs, reject an expired, stale, reused, schema-mismatched, or wrong-revision token, then atomically activate the candidate. The active revision and Sheet remain unchanged on failure.

Accept an empty JSON object to flush pending Backend-owned report projections, or {retryFailed:true} to requeue a bounded batch from the active configuration revision before flushing. Failed-row requeue is audited, capped per item, never revives stale revisions, and every write remains idempotent by tab key, read back, and fail-closed when auth, schema, or write verification is unavailable.
endpoints.GET /api/props/right_server_racks/ea-fac: Read the frontend-safe EA Factory read model only. The request has no body and performs no external read or tool action. It may display the central Sheet id and config revision already owned by the Mission Strategy Table; it never exposes OAuth/service-account credentials, terminal paths, account data, broker data, process ids, or absolute filesystem paths.
endpoints.POST /api/props/right_server_racks/ea-fa: Read verified strategy rows from the fixed Deep_Research tab in the central Sheet configured at the Mission Strategy Table, then map them to the factory's 23 internal strategy fields. Current clients send optional configRevision and idempotencyKey only; legacy googleSheetUrlOrId or tabName values are accepted solely when they match the central contract. Backend may use public CSV or Backend-only auth, creates Mission/report/audit lineage, never writes from the factory, and never advances an EA build.

Accept exactly sourceRecordId, platform, optional brief, and optional idempotencyKey. Backend resolves the opaque source record, creates one manual EA Factory build and immutable Strategy Spec inside the managed Workspace, and does not generate, compile, backtest, schedule, loop, or trade inline.

Accept exactly stageId and optional idempotencyKey. Backend resolves the opaque build id and may advance at most the exact next stage once; it rejects skipped, repeated, concurrent, or out-of-order stages and never treats static review, process exit, or terminal selection as Compile/Strategy Tester proof.
endpoints.GET /api/props/right_server_racks/ea-fac: Stream one allowlisted EA Factory artifact through opaque buildId and fileId values. This same-origin read has no request body or domain/external side effects; Backend appends a local audit event when the stream is requested. It never returns a local/absolute path, directory listing, secret, credential, terminal metadata, or unsupported file type.
endpoints.GET /api/tools: Read the sanitized tool permission matrix.
endpoints.GET /api/orchestration: Read Manager delegation, model tier, budget, and approval policy.
endpoints.GET /api/mission-strategy-table: Read a compact cursor page of Mission and report summaries by default. scope=all, admin, or full explicitly returns the complete frontend-safe diagnostic archive.
endpoints.GET /api/reports: Read structured runtime report cards with frontend-safe metadata and opaque image attachment URLs.
endpoints.GET /api/reports/{reportId}: Read one complete frontend-safe report by exact id. Mission Table summary rows use this endpoint lazily.
endpoints.GET /api/reports/{reportId}/attachments/: Stream one allowlisted PNG, JPEG, or WebP report image through a same-origin opaque attachment id. Local paths and unsupported files are never returned.

providerFieldsInspected: error_description only for an allowlisted client_secret-missing signature

research_sheet_hub.successRule: Frontend may show connected success only for the active configRevision when all three fixed consumers are applied, each consumer has readReady true with per-tab read evidence, and the aggregate readReady and allConsumersVerified fields are true.

failClosedStatusRules.auth_required: A Sheet is configured but no complete Backend-only Google credential is available; no authenticated read or write may be claimed.
failClosedStatusRules.permission_denied: Backend credentials exist but cannot read one or more required tabs; the candidate cannot activate and the active revision remains unchanged.
failClosedStatusRules.schema_mismatch: At least one fixed tab or required header is missing; the affected consumer cannot read or write.
failClosedStatusRules.read_ready_write_unverified: All fixed schemas were read successfully for the current configuration, but no same-revision write plus read-back has been verified.
failClosedStatusRules.ready: The current configuration passed schema verification and at least one idempotent write was confirmed by Google and exact read-back at the same configRevision.

syncGoogleSheet.legacyCompatibility: googleSheetUrlOrId and tabName are accepted only when they match the central Sheet id and fixed Deep_Research tab

googleSheets.sourceRangeRequired: A-AW (49 required headers; extra columns allowed)
googleSheets.internalMapping: 23 EA strategy fields (not a Sheet range)
googleSheets.transport: HTTPS public CSV export with Backend-authenticated read fallback

platformProof.mt4: Compile and Strategy Tester remain blocked until the exact selected MT4 terminal has verified front-office adapter evidence.
platformProof.mt5: Compile and Strategy Tester remain blocked until the exact selected MT5 terminal has verified front-office adapter evidence.
platformProof.tradingview: Pine Script uses source/static validation only; MetaTrader Compile and Strategy Tester are not applicable.

conditions: bounded internal or public read-only scope

codex_cli.sandbox: read-only in manual_guarded; workspace plus frontend, docs, and assets-source in auto_guarded; a separate explicit digest-bound approved_workspace profile may also write Agent Office project code while runtime and repository state remain denied

approvedWorkspace.purpose: Implement one frozen meeting proposal only after Backend validates and consumes its fresh Mission-bound approval.
approvedWorkspace.readBoundaryEnforcement: Runner instruction; no separate OS read ACL
approvedWorkspace.deleteRenameEnforcement: Runner instruction inside allowed write roots
forbidden: Native Web Search or direct command network
secret, credential, auth, cookie, or runtime-data access

codex_cli.nativeWebSearch: live only for codex_web_research; public read-only research with source URLs and no form submission or sign-in

agent_chat.taskExecution: Backend creates an idempotent Mission only for task_request; Chat itself executes no tools

agent_collaboration.discussionMissionPurpose: durable audit and background-round accounting only

ai_trade_council.dashboardReportScope: chartSnapshot.bars, technicalIndicators.series, and priceActionFeatures are calculated from and retain the full validated source snapshot for display, including up to 1000 closed bars.
ai_trade_council.missionArtifactScope: Before Mission creation Backend slices chartSnapshot.bars to the exact analysisBarCount and recalculates technicalIndicators and priceActionFeatures for that analysis window. sourceBarCount records the larger source snapshot without embedding those extra bars in the Mission artifact.

rolePromptCompaction.technical: All technical module summaries from the complete Mission analysis window plus a size-bounded recent OHLC/core-series suffix. This is distinct from the larger Dashboard source snapshot.
rolePromptCompaction.price_action: All deterministic priceActionFeatures from the complete Mission analysis window plus at most 500 recent OHLC bars. This is distinct from the larger Dashboard source snapshot.

ai_trade_council.technicalInput: all deterministic Core14 module summaries from the exact full closed-bar window plus a prompt-limited recent OHLC/core-series suffix
ai_trade_council.priceActionInput: all deterministic priceActionFeatures from the exact full closed-bar window plus at most 500 recent OHLC bars, without the Technical module payload
ai_trade_council.newsInput: sanitized market metadata without OHLC, technicalIndicators, or priceActionFeatures plus public web evidence

mt4_trade_gateway.dispatchEligibility: same validated snapshot, exactly three distinct Council votes returned, configured 1/3, 2/3, or 3/3 BUY or SELL threshold reached, no opposing BUY/SELL vote, and validated stopLossPrice plus takeProfitPrice
mt4_trade_gateway.signedCommandTransport: HMAC-SHA256 signed envelope over the exact inner command or heartbeat payload; secret key remains backend/local-runner and EA local storage only
liveRequires: EA TrustedSigningKeyId is pinned and matches the Backend active key id
Fresh EA status matches the selected MT4 chart and unanimous Council mission
mt4_trade_gateway.currentLiveAvailability: implemented but off by default; use Shadow first, then Demo, and enable Live only from local MT4 EA Inputs after all signed-command and Risk Guard checks pass
mt4_trade_gateway.executionUnknownRecovery: exact command and optimistic ledger revision only; activate Kill Switch, retain bar claim, no inference, no automatic retry
mt4_trade_gateway.persistentExecutionAuthorization: local MT4 EA GatewayMode, LiveArmed, and TrustedSigningKeyId inputs only; Frontend and AI cannot change these values
mt4_trade_gateway.portfolioPolicyEvidence: Fresh strict status v5 only: portfolioPolicyStatus ready, lowercase SHA-256 digest, account-wide managed-magic scope, normalized managed magic/symbol/timeframe allowlists, same_windows_user_file_common concurrency boundary, and crossVpsDistributedLock false. Status v4/v3 is diagnostic read-only and cannot authorize publication.

mission_worker.shutdown: cancel and verify active process tree
mission_worker.timeoutWatchdog: terminate active process tree and fail the mission without automatic retry

codex_rate_limit_telemetry.source: account/rateLimits/read through the authenticated local Codex app-server
codex_rate_limit_telemetry.executionPolicy: Read-only telemetry. It reports the official quota and never bypasses, resets, or evades a Codex rate limit. Official limitReached=true blocks a new guarded Codex run; unavailable data is never converted to fake zero usage.
